Package domain.controller

Class UserController

java.lang.Object
domain.controller.UserController
public class UserController extends Object
Controller responsible for user-related operations. It acts as a bridge between domain and presentation layers for authentication and statistics (ranking).

      Handles user authentication. Checks if the user exists and if the password is correct.

    • register

      public boolean register(String uName, String psswd1, String psswd2)
      Handles user registration. Checks if the user already exists and if the password is valid (that is, psswd1 = psswd2)
      Parameters:
      uName - The username to be registered.
      psswd1 - The password given by the new username.
      psswd2 - The password confirmation.
      Returns:
      true if a new user was registered successfully.
